raw_segments.text: Pollock scenes, press me not beseech you so there is no tongue that moves, none, none
I th world so soon as yours could win me, so it should now wear their necessity in your
request although twere needful I denied it.
My affairs do even drag me homeward, which to hinder were in your love a whip to me,
my stay to you a charge and trouble, to save both farewell our brother.
